description: Saves a draft brief for a mural and returns a link to it. Use it when someone has described their wall and wants to ask one or more muralists for a price. Side effect: one draft is stored on Muralists for 14 days. It does not contact any artist, create an account or a project, or commit anyone to anything. The draft becomes a project only when a person opens the returned link, logs in or makes a free account, and confirms it; they then choose whom to ask. Fields that are left out stay empty, and the result lists them in `still_open`. Each call stores a new draft.

brand_colours.description: House colours the work should sit with, as hex codes.

budget_max_eur.description: Upper end of the budget in euros, if the person named one.

budget_min_eur.description: Lower end of the budget in euros, if the person named one.

city.description: City or town the wall is in.

description.description: What the person wants, in their own words and language: the idea, the theme, who it is for.

location.description: Where the wall is, in words, e.g. 'side wall of the car park, visible from the railway'.

muralist_ids.description: Muralists the person wants to consider, as ids from search_muralists. They are put in the project's selection; none of them is contacted.

permit_status.description: Whether a permit is needed and how far it is.

timeline.description: When it should be finished, e.g. 'Q2 2027' or 'before the summer holidays'.

title.description: Short name for the project, e.g. 'Mural for the canteen of school De Regenboog'.

wall_access.description: ground: paintable from the ground. equipment: scaffolding or a lift is needed. unknown: the person does not know.

wall_height_m.description: Height of the wall in metres.

wall_material.description: What the wall is made of.

wall_width_m.description: Width of the wall in metres.

name: create_brief_draft

confirm_url.description: The link to the draft. A person who opens it and confirms creates their project.

expires_at.description: ISO date after which the link no longer works.

muralist_ids.description: The muralists that were found and will be in the selection.

still_open.description: Parts of the brief that are not filled in yet. The person can add them after confirming.

title: Prepare a mural brief
